rationale: The sole working evaluation identified the unowned control point as the primary limiter: the proposed forwarder channel was expected to supply distribution and data even though forwarders can substitute their own consulting. One bounded constructor pass therefore changed the customer, paid events, offer, distribution, and compounding mechanism to a direct annual importer relationship in one evidence-selected vertical, with forwarders demoted to optional endpoints and data reuse conditional on explicit contract rights. The cited evidence supports the channel conflict, free filing, public-information baseline, and incumbent pressure; it does not establish the target vertical, demand, prices, conversion, margins, renewal, specialist cost, or data permissions. Those remain hypotheses or unknowns, so the redesign is a structural testable model, not validation.
